QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_INTRO: A notification for every new email of the inbox, as soon as it arrives, also with Quokka closed. For all your mailboxes (main and added accounts) on this device.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_ON: Notifications on: a test notification has just arrived.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_CHECKED: Quokka checks this mailbox every 30 seconds, also with the app closed: last check %AGO% ago.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_NOT_CHECKED: Quokka checks this mailbox every 30 seconds, also with the app closed: the first check comes shortly.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_ON_NO_TEST: Notifications on, but the test notification did not go out: the phone's notification service did not answer. Try again shortly.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_DENIED: Notifications are blocked for Quokka: allow them in the browser's or the phone's settings and try again.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_FAILED: That did not work: try again in a moment.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_NOT_WATCHED: This mailbox cannot be read: if you changed its password, sign out and in again in Quokka.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_SERVICE_OFF: The notifications service does not answer: the sorter is off or not set up.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_IOS: On iPhone and iPad notifications work only from the app on the Home Screen: in Safari tap Share → «Add to Home Screen», open Quokka from there and come back here.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.PUSH_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not allow notifications with Quokka closed.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.APPS_INTRO: From an email you can archive a document in Pelican, put a deadline in Kooka and save invitations in the calendar. It works when you sign in to Quokka with Pocket ID: Wombat knows who you are and which apps you use in your family, nothing to paste.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.APP_OFF: you don't use it in this family
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.APPS_ACCESS_HOWTO: Whoever manages the family in Wombat can give you access to the apps (Family → members).
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.STATE_OFF: This server is not linked to Wombat (QUOKKA_HUB_URL and QUOKKA_HUB_KEY).
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.STATE_NO_POCKET_ID: You signed in with address and password: to link the family apps sign out and choose «Sign in with Pocket ID».
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.STATE_UNKNOWN: Wombat doesn't know you: sign in to Wombat once with Pocket ID, then tap Refresh.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.STATE_NO_FAMILY: In Wombat you have no family where you may use Quokka: ask whoever manages it for access to Quokka.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.STATE_DOWN: Wombat doesn't answer: try again shortly.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.CATEGORIES_INTRO: Incoming emails are sorted into these categories. Choose which to see: the ones turned off disappear from the column, the filters and the rows. The emails stay where they are, and turning a category back on shows them again.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_UNSUBSCRIBE_NO_WAY: This email doesn't say how to unsubscribe
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_KOOKA_SAVE: Kooka did not save the event: try again in a moment.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_INVITE_REPLY: The answer to the organiser did not go out: try again in a moment.
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_NOT_LINKED: %APP% works when you sign in with Pocket ID: Settings → Family apps
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_APP_ACCESS: You don't use %APP% in the family %FAMILY%: ask for access in Wombat
QUOKKA_EXTRAS.ERR_APP_FAMILY: %APP% doesn't know the family yet: sign in to %APP% once with Pocket ID
